title_sq: Tek Selvia, Shitet Njesi Biznesi Me Lokacion Perfekt!!!
description_sq: Tek Selvia, Shitet Njesi Biznesi Me Lokacion Perfekt!!! Ambienti ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje pallati 8 katesh te mireadministruar, te pajisur me ashensor. Ka nje siperfaqe bruto 32m². Organizohet nga nje hapesire e bollshme dhe tualeti. Prona ka nje lokacion perfekt dhe teper te frekuentuar. Ambienti orientohet nga veriu dhe ne pjesen e jashtme ka fasade xhami, qe ben te mundur reklamimin e biznesit. Vendndodhja buze rruge e ben te pershtatshme per te ushtruar veprimtari te ndryshme biznesi si: Laborator Analizash, Zyra te ndryshme, Farmaci, etj.
title_en: In Selvia, a business unit for sale with a perfect location!!!
description_en: In Selvia, a business unit for sale with a perfect location!!! The environment is located on the 0th floor of a well-managed 8-story building, equipped with an elevator. It has a gross surface of 32m². It is organized by a spacious space and toilet. The property has a perfect and very frequented location. The environment is oriented to the north and there is a glass facade on the outside, which makes it possible to advertise the business. The roadside location makes it suitable for carrying out various business activities such as: Analysis Laboratory, various offices, Pharmacy, etc.
